_comment: should: the skill must fire. near_miss: it must not, and shares vocabulary on purpose. A near-miss that fires even once in three runs is a real over-trigger, not noise. All five skills are model-invocable, so co-firing between adjacent skills is the failure to watch: a prompt that fires the wrong skill is not a pass.
